request.spec: The steward's dashboard counts are now over the sheet and all its descendants.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The steward's dashboard counts are now over the sheet and all its descendants.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The steward's dashboard now counts over the sheet and all the sheets below it, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

The fix is one change in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`, in the `dashboard` computed. Its PENDING, REVIEW and overdue counts now cover the sheet's own people plus the people of every descendant sheet. Before, they only covered the sheet itself.

The descendant sheets' people were already being loaded for the "Consolidated over this sheet and its descendants" section, so I reused that data. Nothing changed on the server, in the stored data or in the audit records. The other header counts still cover only the current sheet, and the dashboard is still empty for anyone who isn't a steward.
